description: Three independent front-of-house fixes with no admin dependency: (1) harden resume upload validation to PDF-only (MIME + %PDF magic bytes), <=5 MB, <=3 pages, validated server-side; (2) add a visible Export busy state in the editor; (3) add the second ad-network tag to the site-wide head cleanly without breaking the existing 3nbf4 service worker. These three are independent of each other and of FEAT-002/003; grouped as the 'fixes' slice.
steps: UPLOAD (server): In web/src/pages/api/uploads/index.ts, in the `if (kind === "resume_pdf")` branch, change the size cap from `10 * 1024 * 1024` to `5 * 1024 * 1024` and its message to 'max 5 MB'. After decoding base64 to `bytes`, reject when the first 4 bytes are not 0x25 0x50 0x44 0x46 ('%PDF') with json({error:{code:'NOT_A_PDF',message:'Only PDF files are accepted.'}},400). Count pages by building a Latin1 string from the bytes and matching /\/Type\s*\/Page[^s]/g (treat 0 matches as 1 page); reject when count > 3 with json({error:{code:'TOO_MANY_PAGES',message:'PDF must be 3 pages or fewer.'}},400). Keep the existing uploadTemp/createUpload success flow unchanged.

UPLOAD (client): In web/src/components/workspace/Drawer.tsx onFilePicked, before uploading reject when file.type !== 'application/pdf' with toast('Only PDF files are accepted.','error') and return; reject when file.size > 5*1024*1024 with toast('PDF must be under 5 MB.','error') and return. When the /api/uploads POST or the /api/ai/ingest-resume POST returns a 400/413 with error.code in {NOT_A_PDF, TOO_LARGE, TOO_MANY_PAGES}, show the server error.message (or a mapped friendly message) as toast(...,'error') and abort the ingest instead of replacing the document. Update the dropzone <em> copy 'Click or drop file (Max 10 MB)' to 'PDF · max 5 MB · max 3 pages'.

UPLOAD (secondary, low risk): In web/src/pages/api/ai/ingest-resume.ts leave MAX_B64_BYTES behavior but update the tooLarge() message from 'under 10 MB' to 'under 5 MB' for consistency. Do not change the primary gate (that lives in /api/uploads).

EXPORT: In web/src/components/workspace/Workspace.tsx add `const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);` (mirror the existing exportingAnalysis). In onExport: early-return if `exporting`; setExporting(true) at the start; toast('Exporting…','info') when it begins; setExporting(false) in a finally; add `exporting` to the useCallback deps array. Pass `exporting={exporting}` into the rendered <MenuBar .../>.
EXPORT: In web/src/components/workspace/MenuBar.tsx add `exporting?: boolean` to the Props interface and to the destructured component args. On the Export

AD NETWORK: In web/src/components/Analytics.astro, append after the existing AdSense loader <script>: `<script src="https://quge5.com/88/tag.min.js" data-zone="307858" async data-cfasync="false"></script>` exactly (do not alter attributes). Add a brief HTML comment above it: it is the quge5 ad network, loaded async/non-blocking alongside GA, AdSense and the existing 3nbf4 network; quge5's tag self-registers its own worker, so web/public/sw.js is intentionally left unchanged. Do NOT modify web/public/sw.js.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run check` (cwd web/) passes with no new errors and `npm run build` succeeds.

web/src/pages/api/uploads/index.ts resume_pdf branch rejects non-%PDF bytes, files > 5 MB, and PDFs with > 3 pages, each with a distinct error.code, and still succeeds for a valid <=3-page PDF <=5 MB.

Drawer.tsx rejects non-PDF and >5 MB files client-side with a toast and surfaces server rejection codes as a toast without replacing the loaded document; dropzone copy reads 'PDF · max 5 MB · max 3 pages'.

Workspace.onExport sets/clears an `exporting` flag (guarding double-clicks) and shows an 'Exporting…' info toast; MenuBar shows 'Exporting…' and disables the Export button + File-menu item while exporting.
Analytics.astro contains the quge5 <script> with the exact attributes after the AdSense loader; web/public/sw.js is byte-for-byte unchanged.

findings: IMPLEMENTED. Changes: (1) web/src/pages/api/uploads/index.ts resume_pdf branch now caps at 5MB (code TOO_LARGE), rejects non-%PDF magic bytes (code NOT_A_PDF), and rejects >3 pages via Latin1 scan of /Type /Page[^s] with 0-matches treated as 1 page (code TOO_MANY_PAGES); the primary validation gate lives HERE. (2) web/src/components/workspace/Drawer.tsx onFilePicked now does client pre-checks (file.type!=='application/pdf' and size>5MB -> toast + return) and, critically, the /api/uploads POST is now AWAITED and no longer swallowed in try/catch: on !up.ok it surfaces NOT_A_PDF/TOO_LARGE/TOO_MANY_PAGES via toast and ABORTS the ingest (document is not replaced). Dropzone copy is now 'PDF · max 5 MB · max 3 pages'. (3) web/src/pages/api/ai/ingest-resume.ts tooLarge() message updated to 'under 5 MB' (MAX_B64_BYTES unchanged; NOT the primary gate). (4) Export busy state: Workspace.tsx has `const [exporting, setExporting]`; onExport early-returns if exporting, sets true, toasts 'Exporting…' info, clears in finally, `exporting` added to deps; passes exporting={exporting} to <MenuBar/>. MenuBar.tsx has `exporting?: boolean` prop (default false); mb-right Export button shows 'Exporting…' and disabled={exporting||exportsLeft<=0||!canExport}; File-menu 'Export PDF' disabled={!canExport||exporting}. (5) web/src/components/Analytics.astro has the quge5 <script src="https://quge5.com/88/tag.min.js" data-zone="307858" async data-cfasync="false"></script> appended after the AdSense loader with an explanatory comment. web/public/sw.js NOT modified. VERIFICATION: per user instruction during this step, `npm run check`/`npm run build` were NOT executed; later features should run them once to confirm no new errors. NOTES FOR FEAT-002/003 (admin): existing patterns to reuse are documented in context.json — getOwnerId() prefixes owner_id ('user:'||id), admin Users queries must join ON x.owner_id='user:'||u.id; /api/auth/me currently returns email+name only (add is_admin there); mirror usage.astro/UsagePage/DashboardShell patterns; guard admin server-side via a DB column, never the client.
